problems.PLANT_ID_FORMAT: Use lower-case letters, digits, “.”, “_” and “-”, starting with a letter or digit (at most 80).
problems.PLANT_ID_FORMAT_NAME: Use letters, digits, “.”, “_” and “-”, starting with a letter, digit or “_” (at most 120).
problems.PLANT_ID_TAKEN: Another entry of this kind has this id already.
problems.PLANT_ID_ALIAS: This is still an old id of another entry. An administrator can remove that old id under Settings → Modules → Plant registry.
problems.PLANT_ID_SAME: This is the id it has.
problems.FORBIDDEN: You may not change this entry.
problems.PLANT_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: The entry is not there any more.
problems.PLANT_REMOVE_HAS_ENTRIES: Something still belongs to it. Choose “Also remove what belongs to it” to remove that too.
problems.PLANT_REMOVE_REFERENCED: Other entries that stay still name it.
problems.PLANT_LOCATION_UNKNOWN: Its site has no such place.
problems.PLANT_BUILDING_UNKNOWN: Its site has no such building.
problems.PLANT_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: There is no such device profile.
problems.PLANT_ASSIGNMENT_HAS_SETTINGS: It has interface settings for another device profile. Change its profile on its page.

changeId.title: Change the id of “{{name}}”
changeId.help: Lower-case letters, digits, “.”, “_” and “-”, starting with a letter or digit (at most 80).
changeId.helpName: Letters, digits, “.”, “_” and “-”, starting with a letter, digit or “_” (at most 120).
changeId.aliasNote: Links, bookmarks, API calls and import files keep working: {{ids}} still leads here.

aliases.title: Old ids
aliases.help: Ids of renamed entries still lead to the entries. An old id cannot be used for a new entry until you remove it here.
aliases.removeConfirm: Remove the old id “{{id}}”? Links, bookmarks and files that use it no longer lead to “{{target}}”, and the id is free for a new entry.

bulk.editHelp: Only the fields you fill in change; the others keep their values.
bulk.cascade: Also remove what belongs to it
bulk.cascadeHelp: Without it, an entry that still has assets, devices, KPI instances, links or other parts is refused.
bulk.stepUp: This changes many entries: you will be asked to confirm that it is you.
bulk.nothingSet: Fill in at least one field.
bulk.siteOnly: Building and place apply to the assets of one site: select assets of one site.

mapping.title: Change ids or remove entries (optional)
mapping.help: Give old → new ids. An entry whose old id exists is renamed (not added again) and then updated from the files; its old id keeps working. References in the files follow.
mapping.pasteHelp: One per line: kind,old,new or old,new (CSV), or YAML with kind, old and new.
mapping.upload: Load a CSV or YAML file
mapping.rulesHelp: Rules apply to the ids of the chosen kinds (all kinds when none is chosen), after the list above.

removal.title: Remove entries
removal.removeMissing: Remove entries that are not in the files
removal.removeMissingHelp: Only in the sites and kinds the files list (an asset list of a site, its buildings, its VLANs …), and device profiles and KPI definitions only when a file lists all of them. Nothing outside.
removal.cascade: Also remove what belongs to it
removal.cascadeHelp: Without it, an entry that still has assets, devices, KPI instances, links or other parts is refused.

preview.aliasesHelp: Read as the entries they lead to now.
preview.stepUp: This import renames or removes several entries: you will be asked to confirm that it is you.
preview.confirmRemove_one: Remove {{count}} entry and what goes with it?
preview.confirmRemove_other: Remove {{count}} entries and what goes with them?
